metadata.description: JITX hardware design automation skills for PCB design, component modeling, substrate modeling, circuit creation, signal integrity constraints, and pin assignment flexibility

plugins.name: jitx-skills
plugins.description: JITX workflow skills for PCB design. Use jitx-component-modeler for component creation from datasheets. Use jitx-circuit-builder for wiring circuits, passives, and application circuits. Use jitx-substrate-modeler for capturing information about the fabrication substrate. Use jitx-interconnect-constraints for signal integrity constraints, topology, differential pairs, and protocol-level constraint patterns. Use jitx-pin-assignment for pin assignment patterns including provide/require, pin muxing, DiffPair P/N swapping, PCIe lane ordering, DDR byte/bit swapping, and topology+constraint composition on pin-assigned ports. Use lbstanza for writing, reading, debugging, or explaining LB Stanza (lbstanza) source code — Stanza syntax, the standard library (Core, Math, Collections, Reader, Macro Utilities), packages and `.proj` files, the `deftest` framework, LoStanza/FFI, multimethods, parametric types, sequences, generators, coroutines, exception handling, and macros. Most often paired with `jitx-port-3-to-4` when reading 3.x Stanza JITX designs during a port, but also applies to general Stanza work outside JITX. Note: JITX 3.x (Stanza) is the deprecated line and JITX 4.x (Python) is the supported model going forward — use the `jitx-*` family for new design work. Use jitx-port-3-to-4 for porting JITX 3.x (LB Stanza) PCB designs to JITX 4.x (Python), including construct mapping and pre/post build verification using parallel 3.x + 4.x installs.
